_meta.description: Internal planning baseline for Google Cloud Vertex AI & Model Garden token economics and cascaded routing (used by gcp-agent-architecture-advisor and ai-value-sizing).
_meta.customer_facing_rule: NEVER copy static rates or internal/unreleased model identifiers (such as argon) into a customer-facing deliverable without first verifying live public SKU availability, launch stage (GA vs. Preview), and regional pricing at cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/pricing.
_meta.update_frequency: quarterly or on Vertex AI / Model Garden updates

gemini-3.8-flash.typical_role: Default low-latency agent execution, sub-agent tool calling, query decomposition, chunked RAG synthesis

gemini-3.6-flash.typical_role: High-throughput baseline execution, safety classification, intent routing, and entity extraction

gemini-3-pro.typical_role: Complex multi-step orchestration, final synthesis, policy/legal reasoning, CLA isolated judge

argon.typical_role: Frontier reasoning, deep architectural synthesis, and hard multi-step agent planning

claude-sonnet-5-5.typical_role: Default goal-loop code generation harness (claude-agent-harness) and Pipeline 3 cross-family double-marking judge

claude-opus-5-5.typical_role: High-assurance ZDR peer review (claude-review), complex multi-file goal-loop refactoring, and formal verification

xai/grok-4.6.typical_role: Optional draft generation on Vertex AI Model Garden OpenAPI endpoint

gemini-2.5-flash.typical_role: Legacy GA baseline referenced in Toolbox Asset #16 (Nova Scotia Health load-testing guide)

cascaded_agent_turn.description: Route high-volume sub-agent calls (safety, query decomposition, chunked extraction) to gemini-3.8-flash and reserve gemini-3-pro or argon for final synthesis or hard reasoning.

goal_loop_and_peer_review.description: Use claude-sonnet-5-5 as the default fast goal-loop builder in claude-agent-harness, and route high-complexity builds or ZDR peer reviews to claude-opus-5-5.

vertex_context_caching.description: Cache static system instructions, schemas, and domain glossaries with a 1-hour TTL on Vertex AI (Toolbox Asset #16 Optimization #5).
